description: [Ncloud Storage] Set the Object Lock configuration of a Ncloud Storage bucket (PUT /?object-lock). ObjectLockEnabled is always sent as Enabled; the default retention rule is optional — give mode plus exactly one of days (1-36,500) / years (1-100) to apply it to every new object, or omit mode to send no default retention. GOVERNANCE can be overridden by users with bypass permission; COMPLIANCE cannot be shortened or removed by anyone until it expires — it requires confirm=true. The bucket must have been created with objectLockEnabled=true. Use dryRun=true to preview the XML.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

confirm.description: Required (true) when mode=COMPLIANCE, because COMPLIANCE retention is irreversible

days.description: Default retention period in days, 1-36,500 (with mode; exactly one of days / years)

dryRun.description: If true, returns the XML that would be sent without applying

mode.description: Default retention mode GOVERNANCE | COMPLIANCE. Omit to set no default retention rule

years.description: Default retention period in years, 1-100 (with mode; exactly one of days / years)

name: ncloud_ncs_put_object_lock_configuration
